name: cyber-ui-toolkit

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gamedevland/cyber-ui && npm run build --workspace @gamedevland/cyber-ui-sdk
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sdk && tsc --noEmit -p examples/standalone && tsc --noEmit -p examples/sdk
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build:demo

description: Procedural cyberpunk UI surfaces and host-driven effects for PixiJS 8
